requirements.text: Generated codes are uniformly random from an unambiguous alphabet; custom slugs are validated and reserved words refused
Destinations must be http(s) URLs without credentials, and blocked hosts (including the short domain itself) are refused
Code collisions retry and give up cleanly; custom slugs are unique, also on the database
The redirect route returns 302 with private no-cache headers; unknown codes 404, expired or disabled links 410
Expiry, disabling and click limits are enforced, with click limits exact under concurrent requests
Click counts and stats keep only coarse data (referrer host, country), not full referrer URLs
Links are tenant-isolated and only authorized members can create, change or read them
The management API authenticates, checks origin on writes, limits body size and maps errors

evidence.name: rejection sampling: bytes at or above 228 are discarded
custom slugs: shape, reserved words and uniqueness
URL validation: schemes, credentials, blocked hosts and redirect loops
collisions retry, then fail with exhausted
generated-code collisions use ON CONFLICT and retry
resolve: counts clicks, expiry, disable and max clicks
